4694-5686-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
4694-5686-5805-7306.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-4556--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-4556--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

645-1267-3908-6495.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-6495.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

2281-4247-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-5070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-5070.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
3129-4094-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

5147-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1409-3099-6723-6968.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1368-2079-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2079-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1029-2245-5516.easyPrerequisites: The opponent with Psychic Possession attached controls a creature.
1029-2245-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, goading a creature controlled by the player that has Psychic Possession, causing that player to draw a card, and you to add {R}.
Psychic Possession triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Red Death.
Repeat.

457-1409-6835-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Overseer by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Overseer leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Overseer
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Overseer when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Overseer and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-6835-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1362-1479-3585.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

6252-6441-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
6252-6441-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

240-955-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4681-5170-7286.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2919-4659-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4659-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3054-3416-4063-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-4063-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3705-4050-6351-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

985-3200-4195-4574.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-2511-4336-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1651-2034-2797-4772.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

500-2081-2239.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ardent Elementalist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Ardent Elementalist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2099-2558-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2099-2558-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

282-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-5315-5365.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.
282-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

225-1170-1645-5334-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1645-5334-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2556-2955.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Mnemonic Wall exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-2556-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2534-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a Pirate creature token and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
You have a way to create a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.
2534-5470.description:
Create a Pirate creature token and/or a creature token with changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.
Create a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Coercive Recruiter copy.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-2556-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2103-2556-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}.
2103-2556-5626.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Mnemonic Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3259-4885-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

428-2736-4493-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2736-4493-5096.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

1127-2440-4720.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Spirits.
1127-2440-4720.description:
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Spirits, this combo nets infinite mana.

2146-3831-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Circuit Mender, adding {C}{C}.
When Circuit Mender dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Circuit Mender on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Circuit Mender trigger, causing you to draw Circuit Mender.
Cast Circuit Mender by paying {2}.
When Circuit Mender enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

920-1987-2493-5195.description:
Activate Kaza by tapping it, causing the next instant or sorcery spell you cast to cost at least {2} less.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer and Kaza.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Kaza and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

969-1328-3259-3294.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached to different creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block the creatures with Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached.
969-1328-3259-3294.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creatures that have Spellbinder and Breath of Fury attached.
Spellbinder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of Exotic Pets without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Exotic Pets, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Fish token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2744-2757-4585.notablePrerequisites:
Custodi Soulbinders has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You control a basic Plains.
2034-2744-2757-4585.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Custodi Soulbinders by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Spirit token, untapping a basic Plains.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1656-1835-5137.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-1835-5137.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Zaxara's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

719-1303-1409-2743.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Biovisionary.
"Zombie" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1303-1409-2743.description:
Activate Biovisionary by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Biovisionary enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator and Necroduality.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Biovisionary.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-4 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
